snippet.title: Codex Mortis | Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Codex Mortis is now available in full release on Steam! 

A survivors-like deckbuilder with mutating spells and five schools of dark magic. Build devastating combos, battle through ten cursed levels, and spend earned points on booster packs. Survive the isometric bullet hell solo or in multiplayer.

Play Full Release on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4084120/CODEX_MORTIS/
